Container.Name: pt-tools
Container.Overview: Automation for private tracker (PT) sites: download free torrents from RSS feeds, multi-site search and statistics, check-in, login keep-alive reminders, seed boosting (brush tasks), qBittorrent and Transmission management, and QQ / Telegram ChatOps. PT 站点自动化管理：RSS 自动下载、多站点搜索与数据统计、签到、登录保号提醒、刷流，统一管理 qBittorrent 和 Transmission，支持 QQ 与 Telegram ChatOps。 Default login: admin / adminadmin. Back up secret.key in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Web UI port inside the container is 8080.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, encryption key (secret.key), logs and staged torrents. Keep this folder and back up secret.key.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone used for schedules, daily reports and statistics.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default nobody = 99).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default users = 100).

Config.Name: PT_TOOLS_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional: base64 AES-256 key exported with `pt-tools secret export`. Leave empty to use secret.key in the data folder.
